rows.text: The AICC's highlights of 13 December 2017 describe Shri Rahul Gandhi as 'President-elect, Indian National Congress'; in his Hindi remarks he says he was asked to address the Mahila Congress right after becoming President-elect and calls it his first programme as party president (adhyaksh).
